evi.4wave~.digest: Antialiased Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine simultaneous oscillators
evi.4wave~.description:
evi.4wave~ is a 'max define' for the evi_4wave.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.4wave~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Phase synchronous shared frequency oscillators with simultaneous Saw, Rect, Tri and Sine outputs. Antialiasing method is 4-point polyblep.

evi.adsr~.digest: ADSR envelope generator, similar features to adsr~ but with logarithmic segments
evi.adsr~.description: ADSR by default, but actually DAHDSHR capabale generator via attributes. Logarithmic segment shapes but still capable of controlling poly~ and thispoly~.

evi.algoverb~.description: Relatively expensive algorithmic reverb with many tweekable parameters, 15 embedded presets and an internal pattrstorage system. The reverb is modular, with pre delay, early reflections and late reflections all controllable individually, as well as linear TPT SVF filters in both the feedback path and end of wet path.

evi.allpass~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP allpass~ filter delay
evi.allpass~.description:
evi.allpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_allpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.allpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Cubic interpolated allpass filter delay unit. The same structure as MSP allpass~, but with cubic interpolation for smoother high end decays, and a tamed gain coefficient so no digital clipping or aliasing. A bit different to the MSP. This abstraction also includes an optional feedbackmix attribute which does ridiculous nonlinear comb effects (default off).

evi.am~.digest: Basic AM processor with saturation and choice of LFO shapes
evi.am~.description:
evi.am~ is a 'max define' for the evi_am.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.am~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A basic but useful AM processor with the core basic algorithm and assocoiated cotrols surrounded by saturation when driving the modulation signal > 0 dB. The saturation is antialiased and can cope with very hot input and has the feel of a guitar pedal. Because everybody needs a bosom for a pillow.

evi.arpnotch~.digest: A nonlinear SVF Notch filter which can morph between LP..Notch..HP
evi.arpnotch~.description:
evi.arpnotch~ is a 'max define' for the evi_arpnotch.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.arpnotch~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A nonlinear 12dB SVF filter which can smoothly morph between LP..Notch..HP, thus making it a partial emulation of the ARP 1047 filter/resonator. The morphing through notch is resonance-compensated so that the analog notch is always strong.

evi.audiodust~.description:
evi.audiodust~ is a 'max define' for the evi_audiodust.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.audiodust~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Audio dust is a sparse random noise source driven at a given frequency. It produces 'spikes' at random amplitude and time offsets. It can be very useful as both a control signal and an audio signal. @see: 'evi_sources.genexpr' for more where this came from.

evi.backverb~.digest: Ursa Major reverb unit with saturating feedback
evi.backverb~.description: A strange reverb-like effect, based on Christopher Moore's legendary 1978 Ursa Major Space Station algorithm. This is not an attempt to model the 1970's digital hardware, but more of a trope on it, although it does sound very close to the original with the right settings. Nonlinearities and trap filters have been added, much as you might find in an analog delay, as well as different modulation, interpolation, smoothing and filtering modifications. Also cheap on CPU.

evi.baxandall~.digest: Emulation of a classic baxandall EQ
evi.baxandall~.description:
evi.baxandall~ is a 'max define' for the evi_baxandall.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.baxandall~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An EQ tone control shape popularised in the 1950s, often used in HiFi equipment and guitar amplifiers. Baxandall is a special EQ as the frequency response is fixed, and depends on the simple high level gain control inputs ('treble' and 'bass').

evi.biquad.filter~.digest: All-in-one audio rate biquad coefficients calculator and filter section. With selection of 40 different filter types.
evi.biquad.filter~.description:
evi.biquad.filter~ is a 'max define' for the evi_biquad_filter.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.biquad.filter~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Coefficients calculator and internal biquad filter section for all-in-one biquad filtering. High level filter parameters are frequency, gain and Q. The units used for frequency and gain can be set via attributes.

evi.biquadcoeff.digest: Message rate biquad coefficients calculator with selection of 40 different filter types
evi.biquadcoeff.description: evi.biquadcoeff is an efficient message rate coefficients calculator for the biquad~ (or evi.biquad~) object. It is intended to replace filtergraph~ for when you do not need a UI or you want to take advantage of the more filter types available. High level filter parameters are frequency, gain and Q. The units used for frequency and gain can be set via attributes.

evi.biquadcoeff~.digest: Audio rate biquad coefficients calculator with selection of 40 different filter types.
evi.biquadcoeff~.description:
evi.biquadcoeff~ is a 'max define' for the evi_biquad_coeff.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.biquadcoeff~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

evi.biquadcoeff~ is an audio rate coefficients calculator for the biquad~ (or evi.biquad~) object. High level filter parameters are frequency, gain and Q. The units used for frequency and gain can be set via attributes.

evi.blitwaves~.digest: No aliasing BLIT oscillators with a choice of simultaneous wave shapes outputs
evi.blitwaves~.description:
evi.blitwaves~ is a 'max define' for the evi_blitwaves.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.blitwaves~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

No aliasing classic synth wave shapes, DSF-BLIT-like algorithm, sweep/modulation works with no noise, and cheap. Good for subtractive synthesis because we stay very bright right up to nyquist, but no hard sync.

evi.bp~.description:
evi.bp~ is a 'max define' for the evi_bp.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.bp~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A linear twopole resonant bandpass filter, a port of [bp~] from Pd and therefore a direct form biquad. Similar to reson~ and evi.reson~ but with no feedforward gains and thus a special and smooth alternative to those filters. Like reson etc it can take very high Q values which is one of it's primary use cases. [bp~] is basically a control rate version of [vcf~] from Pd, which is also ported in evieve as evi.vcf~.

evi.butterworthlp6~.digest: Unique 6th order Butterworth Lowpass filter created from evi.bp~ sections after Miller Puckette
evi.butterworthlp6~.description:
evi.butterworthlp6~ is a 'max define' for the evi_butterworthlp6.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.butterworthlp6~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A smooth 6th order butterworth lowpass with very interesting properties being made up of three resonant filter sections.

evi.butterworthlp8~.digest: Variable order TPT Butterworth Lowpass filter
evi.butterworthlp8~.description:
evi.butterworthlp8~ is a 'max define' for the evi_butterworthlp8.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.butterworthlp8~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This is a clean, linear, surgical filter but can still be updated alias-free at audio rate if required. Very useful for clean top and tail of audio chains.

evi.cfsmooth~.digest: Signal smoother particularly well suited to smoothing filter cutoff frequencies
evi.cfsmooth~.description: Based on Andy Simper's smoother, evi.cfsmooth~ tracks the input value via the bandpass output of an SVF filter and logarithmically updates. Smoothing is specified in both ramp time (ms) and filter cutoff (Hz).

evi.chorus.digital~.digest: A basic digital Chorus implementation, with multiple stages and saturation
evi.chorus.digital~.description:
evi.chorus.digital~ is a 'max define' for the evi_chorus_digital.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.chorus.digital~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An example of a multi stage chorus using evieve primitives. There are many attributes so that the user can macroise the controls themselves to higher level parameters.

evi.classic.osc~.description:
evi.classic.osc~ is a 'max define' for the evi_classic_osc.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.classic.osc~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Provides classic oscillator shapes (sine, tri, saw, rect) using a 2-point polyblep algorithm. Optionally including PWM versions (@type attribute). Also offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

evi.clipasym~.description:
evi.clipasym~ is a 'max define' for the evi_clipasym.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.clipasym~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Vaguely inspired by the nonlinear part of the K35 chip in the Korg MS10 filter. This has similar asymmetric nonlinear behaviour. The antialiasing here is not as successful as in other evieve objects, so be careful not to drive it too hard.

evi.clipper~.digest: Antialiased clipping algorithms for your audio
evi.clipper~.description:
evi.clipper~ is a 'max define' for the evi_clipper.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.clipper~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A collection of four antialiased clipping algorithms: hard clip, soft clip, diode clip, asymmetric clip. Hard and soft are better antialiased and can take higher input gain before aliasing than the diode and asymmetric clippers. To be used whenever clamping of audio is required, evi.clipper~ should do a good job of protecting your precious audio.

evi.comb~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP comb~ filter delay
evi.comb~.description:
evi.comb~ is a 'max define' for the evi_comb.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.comb~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Comb filter delay unit with saturation in the feedback path. The same structure as MSP comb~, but with cubic interpolation (softer in the high end) and no digital clipping at FB Gain == 1 (via internal saturation, which makes the whole filter softer but will not clip your precious audio).

evi.cross~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP cross~ filter as Likwitz-Riley
evi.cross~.description:
evi.cross~ is a 'max define' for the evi_cross.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.cross~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

evi.cross~ differs from MSP cross~ in the following ways: evi.cross~ is a steeper 4-pole crossover slope ( cross~ is a 3-pole slope), because 3rd order is not possible with flat summing Linkwitz-Riley. evi.cross~ is a proper Linkwitz-Riley crossover which sums perfectly flat (whereas cross~ is pure Butterworths and sums with a +3dB bump). evi.cross~ remains stable under modulation. For a shallower 2-pole Linkwitz-Riley crossover @see evi.crossover~.

evi.crossover.3band~.description:
evi.crossover.3band~ is a 'max define' for the evi_crossover_3band.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.crossover.3band~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Linkwitz-Riley crossovers sum perfectly flat on recombination of the outputs (providing allpass alignment is used). Use evi.crossover.3band~ to achieve multiband processing. @see the 'seealso' section for other evieve objects that can help with this.

evi.crossover.allpass~.digest: Allpass filter for aligning audio bands using evieve crossover filters
evi.crossover.allpass~.description:
evi.crossover.allpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_crossover_allpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.crossover.allpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Multiband Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters require alpass alignment. This filter gives access to the same filters used in all the evieve crossover filters, in case a custom summing method is wished for.

evi.crossover.sum~.digest: Summing, including allpass alignment, for use with evi.crossover.3band~
evi.crossover.sum~.description:
evi.crossover.sum~ is a 'max define' for the evi_crossover_sum.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.crossover.sum~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Linkwitz-Riley crossovers sum perfectly flat on recombination of the outputs (providing allpass alignment is used). Use evi.crossover.sum~ to sum multiband processing created with the evi.crossover.3band~ object. @see the 'seealso' section for other evieve objects that are related.

evi.crossover~.digest: A choice of 2 or 4 pole Linkwitz-Riley crossover filters
evi.crossover~.description:
evi.crossover~ is a 'max define' for the evi_crossover.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.crossover~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Linkwitz-Riley crossovers sum perfectly flat on recombination of the outputs. Use evi.crossover~ to achieve multiband processing. @see the 'seealso' section for other evieve objects that can help with this.

evi.damp.macro~.digest: A 'one knob' macroisation for simple low/high onepole damping filters
evi.damp.macro~.description:
evi.damp.macro~ is a 'max define' for the evi_damp_macro.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.damp.macro~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A 'one knob' ('damp' parameter) macroisation for quick onepole damping filters useful for light damping or inside a feedback loop. For a similar filter with more controls @see: evi.damp~.

evi.damp~.digest: Onepole pass/shelf damping filters with simultaneous outputs
evi.damp~.description:
evi.damp~ is a 'max define' for the evi_damp.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.damp~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Two very efficient damping filters in series. A lowpass/highshelf filter (left outlet) and a highpass/lowshelf filter (right outlet). The frequency and damping inlets control both filters simultaneously for high level attenuation control. Useful for damping in reverbs and other situations. With the 'damp' inlet at 0.71..0.99 the first lowpass outlet is similar to MSP [onepole~] (depending on Hz).

evi.dcblock~.description: A basic dc blocking filter utility for cleaning your audio signals.

evi.detune.wrap~.digest: A quirky digital Detune effect with filtering and saturation
evi.detune.wrap~.description:
evi.detune.wrap~ is a 'max define' for the evi_detune_wrap.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.detune.wrap~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Loosely based on 'mda detune' copyright (c) 1998-2000 Paul Kellett. evi.detune.wrap~ adds a feedback path as would be found in modulation effects, and implements a linkwitz-riley crossover to shift the focus and strength of the effect. In addition a dynamically controllable morphing pre-filter can accentuate certain frequencies hitting the detuner. Feedback path and output are saturated and antialiased. See evi.detune~ for a much simpler and efficient version of this algorithm.

evi.detune~.digest: A quirky digital Detune effect, LoFi and old school
evi.detune~.description:
evi.detune~ is a 'max define' for the evi_detune.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.detune~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Loosely based on 'mda detune' copyright (c) 1998-2000 Paul Kellett. Includes a linkwitz-riley crossover to shift the focus and strength of the effect. See evi.detune.wrap~ for a more complex and expensive version of this algorithm.

evi.dfm~.digest: Classic MS20 filter emulation based on DFM1 by Tony Hardie-Bick
evi.dfm~.description: This is a well known open source MS20 filter emulation of the old school. The agressive character of the MS20 is captured as a defining feature. The scaling of frequency and Q is a feature of the original filter and is maintained here, measured against an actual MS20 filter control response. Like the MS20 filter, the filter is switchable here between the 12dB Lowpass and 6dB (special) Highpass responses. Note: internal smoothing of cutoff (@smooth, default on) is cheap but causes (interesting?) artifacts with fast sweeps downwards. For clean sweeping turn @smooth off (set to '0') and smooth cutoff externally.

evi.eq3.stereo~.digest: Stereo TPT 3-band EQ with audio rate modulation of all parameters
evi.eq3.stereo~.description:
evi.eq3.stereo~ is a 'max define' for the evi_eq3_stereo.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.eq3.stereo~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A stereo 3-band EQ made up of left and right sets of 3 TPT SVF EQ filters, each with selectable filter type. The feature of this EQ is that all filter parameters are available on inlets, so the whole EQ can optionally be audio rate modulated. Because this is based on TPT filters, modulation will remain clean and stable at audio rate, unlike biquads.

evi.eq3~.digest: Mono TPT 3-band EQ with audio rate modulation of all parameters
evi.eq3~.description:
evi.eq3~ is a 'max define' for the evi_eq3.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.eq3~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A 3-band EQ made up of 3 TPT SVF EQ filters, each with selectable filter type. The feature of this EQ is that all filter parameters are available on inlets, so the whole EQ can optionally be audio rate modulated. Because this is based on TPT filters, modulation will remain clean and stable at audio rate, unlike biquads.

evi.eq5~.digest: 5-band TPT EQ with message rate control of all parameters
evi.eq5~.description:
evi.eq5~ is a 'max define' for the evi_eq5.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.eq5~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A 5-band parametric EQ made up of 5 TPT SVF EQ filters, each with selectable filter type. Parameter changes can optionally be smoothed.

evi.eq8~.digest: 8-band TPT EQ with message rate control of all parameters
evi.eq8~.description:
evi.eq8~ is a 'max define' for the evi_eq8.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.eq8~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An 8-band parametric EQ made up of 8 TPT SVF EQ filters, each with selectable filter type. Parameter changes can optionally be smoothed. evi.eq8~ uses the same filter DSP and offers the same filter types as Ableton 'EQ8'.

evi.expsmooth~.description: A simple and efficient ramp generator with exponential curve and ramp time specified in milliseconds.

evi.filter.allpass~.description:
evi.filter.allpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_allpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.allpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The allpass filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. An allpass filter 'roughly determines a 90 degree transition in phase on either side of center frequency'. Note there is no gain control in this filter.

evi.filter.bandpass~.description:
evi.filter.bandpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_bandpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.bandpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The bandpass filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. '...bandwidth at -3dB from center freq'.

evi.filter.bell~.description:
evi.filter.bell~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_bell.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.bell~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The bell filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. '...bandwidth at -3dB/+3dB from center freq'. Also with analog 'adaptive Q' option.

evi.filter.eq~.digest: EQ type TPT filters with a choice of 7 filters
evi.filter.eq~.description:
evi.filter.eq~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_eq.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.eq~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This filter block can be switched between 7 different EQ filter types. The filter is a clean twopole TPT SVF section which can be used in place of a biquad as it has superior properties to a biquad. It is designed to be an every day patching workhorse for most EQ filtering needs. Each individual filter type can also be instantiated in it's own all-in-one block, see the 'seealso' for details. The TPT SVF is used all over evieve whenever basic EQ filtering is required.

evi.filter.highpass~.description:
evi.filter.highpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_highpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.highpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The highpass filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection.

evi.filter.highshelf~.description:
evi.filter.highshelf~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_highshelf.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.highshelf~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The highshelf filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. '...determining transition width at -3dB/+3dB from center freq'.

evi.filter.lowpass~.description:
evi.filter.lowpass~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_lowpass.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.lowpass~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The lowpass filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection.

evi.filter.lowshelf~.description:
evi.filter.lowshelf~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_lowshelf.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.lowshelf~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The lowshelf filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. '...determining transition width at -3dB/+3dB from center freq'.

evi.filter.morph~.digest: TPT SVF which can morph between LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP. A morphing version of evi.svf~.
evi.filter.morph~.description:
evi.filter.morph~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_morph.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.morph~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Twopole TPT SVF morphing filter. The filter is a single section which can morph LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP via 0..1 'Morph' control (inlet 5) with a single outlet.

evi.filter.notch~.description:
evi.filter.notch~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_notch.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.notch~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The notch filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. '...determining bandwidth at -3dB from center freq'.

evi.filter.peak~.description:
evi.filter.peak~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_peak.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.peak~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The peak filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. Peak only. For peak/notch @see evi.filter.bell~.

evi.filter.resonant~.description:
evi.filter.resonant~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_resonant.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.resonant~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The resonant filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. '...determining bandwidth at -3dB from center freq'. For a resonant filter with more options @see evi.reson~.

evi.filter.shelving~.digest: A chain of two twopole TPT SVF High/Low shelving filters
evi.filter.shelving~.description:
evi.filter.shelving~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_shelving.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.shelving~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A quick one stop shop for applying classic shelving filtering using high quality linear TPT SVFs. Controls are via attributes.

evi.filter.tilt~.description:
evi.filter.tilt~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter_tilt.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter.tilt~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The tilt filter from the evieve TPT SVF collection. A tilt filter is a special type of shelf: negative dB boosts low and attenuates high frequencies, positive dB boosts high and attenuates low frequencies.

evi.filter~.digest: All-in-one TPT twopole filter section with a choice of 12 different filter types
evi.filter~.description:
evi.filter~ is a 'max define' for the evi_filter.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.filter~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This filter block can be switched between 12 different filter types. The filter is a clean twopole TPT SVF section which can be used in place of a biquad as it has superior properties to a biquad. It is designed to be an every day patching workhorse for most linear filtering needs. Each individual filter type can also be instantiated in it's own all-in-one block, see the 'seealso' for details. The TPT SVF is used all over evieve whenever basic filtering is required.

evi.flanger.digital~.digest: A basic two-stage Flanger effect with saturation
evi.flanger.digital~.description:
evi.flanger.digital~ is a 'max define' for the evi_flanger_digital.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.flanger.digital~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A basic flanger example created from classic comb filter blocks. Triangle/sine LFO types can be morphed and skewed. Multiple controls for manipulation of audio mix.

evi.formantfilter.morph~.digest: A formant filter with smoothly morphing singing voice type, sung vowel sounds and filter types.
evi.formantfilter.morph~.description: While evi.formantfilter~ uses a bank of resonant filters, evi.formantfilter.morph~ uses a bank of morphing EQ filters. The formant effect is lesser, but the morphing ability creates new sonic possibilities. The far right 'Morph' inlet allows for morphing the internal bank of filters between LP..BP..HP..NOTCH..LP 0..1, and adds another dimension along with the voice and vowel morphing to shape the sound. All inputs can be audio rate modulated.

evi.formantfilter~.digest: A classic formant filter which can smoothly morph singing voice type and sung vowel sounds for voxy filtering effects on your audio streams
evi.formantfilter~.description: evi.formantfilter~ uses a bank of resonant filters (the same TPT filters as in evi.reson~) for each formant. Interpolation and warping controls allow for a wide variety of effects, as well as controlling the filters themselves.

evi.formantosc~.digest: A classic formant oscillator which can smoothly morph singing voice type and sung vowel sounds for voxy effects.
evi.formantosc~.description: evi.formantosc~ allows for smoothly interpolating vowels and voices over a fundamental frequency. It gives the classic lofi physical model effect but with many attributes to modify the output and audio rate modulate it for an interesting source.

evi.formletfilter~.description:
evi.formletfilter~ is a 'max define' for the evi_formletfilter.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.formletfilter~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A physical modelling ringing formlet filter loosely based on SuperCollider 'Formlet()' with added modulation and control features. Created by adding two resonant filters together around a center frequency. Can create ringing tones out of any input material. This is a direct form filter, so modulation is limited.

evi.freezeverb~.digest: Classic freeverb reverb algorithm with buttery smooth freezing effect
evi.freezeverb~.description: This is a basic Schroeder reverb effect but with additional filtering and controls, very servicable for certain situations. But the main feature here is the ability to smoothly capture the input audio in the recirculating feedback path in a way which gives a forever freezing effect. This can be triggered and released with wet+dry or with wet alone.

evi.freqshift.hilbert~.digest: Time-domain Hilbert frequency shifter effect with three simultaneous sidebands outputs
evi.freqshift.hilbert~.description: It sounds like MSP freqshift~ but with a different hilbert filter and additional features, such as antialiased saturation and automatic clickless phase reset.

evi.freqshift.weaver~.digest: Time domain frequency shifter after D. K. Weaver's 'third method'
evi.freqshift.weaver~.description:
evi.freqshift.weaver~ is a 'max define' for the evi_freqshift_weaver.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.freqshift.weaver~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Time domain frequency shifter. Not like MSP freqshift~. An implementation of D. K. Weaver's famous 'third method' (unlike freqshift~, fbinshift~ and evi.freqshift.hilbert~ which implement the more usual hilbert filtering 'second method'). N.B. no filtering shift here, all done with quadrature oscillators and lowpass filters. Includes antialiased saturation and automatic clickless phase reset.

evi.gaussiannoise~.description:
evi.gaussiannoise~ is a 'max define' for the evi_gaussiannoise.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.gaussiannoise~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An approximate 'Box-Muller' gaussian noise distribution. It looks roughly the same as white noise in a spectral view, very slightly different in a scope~. In a histogram one can see the distribution. The point is the gaussian random number distribution.

evi.gigaverb~.digest: Classic gigaverb reverb algorithm, mono in / stereo out, fdn / allpass
evi.gigaverb~.description: A mono-in, stereo-out reverb implementation by Juhana Sadeharju. Originally Max/MSP-ified by Olaf Matthes (2004) Version 1.0test5, (c) 1999-2006 Juhana Sadeharju / Olaf Matthes. Originally Gen-ified by Graham Wakefield (2011). 64-bit MSP reference version by Volker Böhm (2016). This evieve version with updated filtering and parameter smooting.

evi.hardclip~.description:
evi.hardclip~ is a 'max define' for the evi_hardclip.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.hardclip~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

To be used whenever clamping of audio is required, evi.hardclip~ should do a good job of protecting your precious audio. This is because this is antialiased hard clipping capable of high input gain whilst maintaining audio quality. evi.hardclip~ is the hard clipping section from the evi.clipper~ object but with more antiderivative and oversampling options for when managing audio quality against CPU usage, selected via the @aa attribute. Increasing @aa does not necessarily translate to 'better'. Experiment with this setting depending on your audio input material.

evi.hilbert~.description: Hilbert quadrature (phase shift) filter using an 8th order polyphase IIR halfband allpass cascade.

evi.korgms10~.digest: 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
evi.korgms10~.description:
evi.korgms10~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms10.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms10~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The 'Korg 35' chip was found in the MS-10 and early MS-20 synthesisers - different to the later dual-amplifier Korg OTA chip found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers.

evi.korgms20.select~.digest: Korg OTA dual-amplifier buffered modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation
evi.korgms20.select~.description:
evi.korgms20.select~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms20_select.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms20.select~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The 'KLM' OTA chip was found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers - it is different to the earlier 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered Korg chip found in the earlier MS-20s and MS-10 and also in the 'monotron' series. This is a fabricated evieve version able to smoothly switch (with a nice 'plop') between 12dB LP and 6dB HP filter types, realised in transposed TPT form. With 2x oversampling option.

evi.korgms20~.digest: Korg OTA dual-amplifier modified Sallen-Key topology nonlinear filter emulation with simultaneous outputs
evi.korgms20~.description:
evi.korgms20~ is a 'max define' for the evi_korgms20.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.korgms20~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The 'KLM' OTA chip was found in the later MS-20s and other Korg synthesisers - it is different to the earlier 'Korg 35' single-amplifier unbuffered Korg chip found in the earlier MS-20s and MS-10 and also in the 'monotron' series. This Korg filter sits inbetween the more broken evi.korgms10~ and the more stable evi.korgms20.select~. It is aggressive but predictable.

evi.ladder.diode~.digest: TPT nonlinear Diode Ladder filter emulation
evi.ladder.diode~.description:
evi.ladder.diode~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ladder_diode.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ladder.diode~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A 24dB Diode Ladder filter emulation, similar to the Roland-TB303 filter and not like a Transistor Ladder. Different to any of the other evieve Ladders. Unlike the (Moog) Transistor Ladder, the Diode Ladder resonance peaks, rather than scales. So be careful with high resonance! The object provides two FM modulation inlets for the filter cutoff frequency.

evi.ladder.moog~.description:
evi.ladder.moog~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ladder_moog.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ladder.moog~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A classic nonlinear Moog Ladder emulation. This is the smoothest and most in tune of all the evieve TPT Ladders and handles high resonance very well. It responds particularly well to and remains stable under audio rate modulation, therefore capable of all the classic analog Ladder effects.

evi.ladder.poles~.digest: TPT nonlinear transistor Ladder filter emulation with switchable (interpolated) poles
evi.ladder.poles~.description:
evi.ladder.poles~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ladder_poles.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ladder.poles~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

By default another 24dB Ladder emulation via piecewise approximation, but poles can be interpolated to a 18dB, 12dB and 6dB filter. These are not allpass aligned so technically incorrect, but sound interesting and can be useful. For a 'correct' 12dB ladder see evi.lorez~ (with a 'z').

evi.ladder.transistor~.digest: Nonlinear TPT Transistor Ladder filter emulation
evi.ladder.transistor~.description:
evi.ladder.transistor~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ladder_transistor.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ladder.transistor~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A dirty nonlinear 24dB Transistor Ladder filter emulation. The object provides two FM modulation inlets for the filter cutoff frequency. This filter has been tuned to be quite 'hot' and aggressive compared to the evi.ladder.moog~ object, which may be preferable if a clean sound is required.

evi.lagsmooth~.digest: Smooth signal ramp generator with logarithmic curve
evi.lagsmooth~.description: Complex ramp generator with smooth logarithmic curve that reaches it's destination within a threshold of -80dB.

evi.limiterfast~.digest: A fast no-lookahead limiter with antialiased nonlinear clipping
evi.limiterfast~.description:
evi.limiterfast~ is a 'max define' for the evi_limiterfast.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.limiterfast~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A very basic stereo limiter. Being a no-lookahead limiter, the 'crunch' can kick in quite easily. evi.limiterfast~ features an antialiased antiderivative hard clipping function to deal with this. Other than that it features fixed hard attack, a settable soft knee, variable smoothing, release time set in ms. The AGC envelope is available at the far right outlet.

evi.logsmooth~.description: A simple and extremely efficient ramp generator with logarithmic curve and ramp time specified in milliseconds.

evi.lores~.description:
evi.lores~ is a 'max define' for the evi_lores.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.lores~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This filter roughly matches the shape and behaviour of MSP lores~ but is implemented as a TPT filter. lores~ is basically like the lowpass output of svf~ but with a unique mapping and coupling of cutoff and resonance: frequency affects strength of resonance and resonance affects slope of filter. The mapping of lores~ has a lower resonance in the low frequency range. This is actually a traditional analog SVF type of mapping. evi.lores~ matches all these features but does not quite manage to match the high frequency response. This is a trade off for having a filter with better modulation properties and which does not digitally distort. The abstraction includes code which can be extracted for parameter rate control of the coefficients calculation if required.

evi.lorez~.digest: A novel two-pole nonlinear Ladder filter
evi.lorez~.description:
evi.lorez~ is a 'max define' for the evi_lorez.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.lorez~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Nonlinear 12dB TPT Lowpass with excellent modulation properties and allpass alignment. Capable of all audio rate modulation with cutoff FM-able whilst remaining stable. Resonance stays strong even in lower frequencies. The abstraction includes code which can be extracted for parameter rate control of the coefficients calculation and linear operation if required.

evi.lpg~.digest: Buchla Lowpass Gate emulation for your west coast synthesis fun
evi.lpg~.description: Circuit modelled emulation of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate, unique version of a two-pole Sallen and Key filter, based on 'A Digital Model of the Buchla Lowpass-Gate' by Julian Parker and Stefano DAngelo, 2013 . In evieve this is all audio rate inputs to control the voltage input to the gate, with additional features such as extra feedback resistors ( boom ) and simultaneous filter outputs. Refactored code for optimal CPU usage.

evi.mattaverb~.digest: True stereo one knob allpass diffuse reverb
evi.mattaverb~.description: A simple allpass diffusion reverb with minimal controls interaction. True stereo input/output, no early reflections, designed wet and spacey but very dampable.

evi.modalres~.description:
evi.modalres~ is a 'max define' for the evi_modalres.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.modalres~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Modified coupled form (MCF) complex multiply sine oscillator based twopole resonator with damping. ('Follow a fixed elliptical orbit over time').

evi.modosc~.digest: A deluxe cosine LFO with range and offset shaping
evi.modosc~.description:
evi.modosc~ is a 'max define' for the evi_modosc.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.modosc~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A simple sine oscillator for modulation purposes with sample accurate and clickless automatic phase reset when Hz input == 0, along with range and offset mapping.

evi.morph.trap~.digest: A selection of morphing trapezoidal antialiased oscillators
evi.morph.trap~.description:
evi.morph.trap~ is a 'max define' for the evi_morph_trap.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.morph.trap~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An oscillator with multiple optional shapes, each based around the same trapezoid wave but each with different morphing capabilities. Each shape option is phase synchronous and can be sample accurately switched at 'Morph' == 0.5. Also offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

evi.morph.tri~.digest: A selection of morphing triangular antialiased oscillators
evi.morph.tri~.description:
evi.morph.tri~ is a 'max define' for the evi_morph_tri.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.morph.tri~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An oscillator with multiple optional shapes, each based around the same triangle wave but each with different morphing capabilities. Each shape option is phase synchronous and can be sample accurately switched at 'Morph' == 0.5. Also offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

evi.multimode~.digest: Simultaneous outputs for all filters available from a linear TPT SVF
evi.multimode~.description:
evi.multimode~ is a 'max define' for the evi_multimode.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.multimode~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A multimode SVF similar to evi.svf~. Seven simultaneous outputs for all filters available from a linear TPT SVF topology that use just Cutoff and Q, with optional cutoff and resonance smoothing baked in.

evi.onepole.shelving~.digest: Onepole shelving filters with simultaneous outputs
evi.onepole.shelving~.description:
evi.onepole.shelving~ is a 'max define' for the evi_onepole_shelving.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.onepole.shelving~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Onepole low/high shelving filter using trapezoidal integration, simultaneous outputs, very smooth and very cheap. Frequency input in Hz, shelving input is linear -1..0..1, optional smoothing attributes are default off.

evi.onepole~.digest: Linear trapezoidal integrated onepole filter with simultaneous outputs for lowpass, allpass and highpass
evi.onepole~.description:
evi.onepole~ is a 'max define' for the evi_onepole.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.onepole~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Three matched onepole filters in Lowpass, Allpass and Highpass types at three independent outputs. An efficient workhorse onepole for all generic patching needs.

evi.overdrive.env~.digest: Antialiased passive tanh-like input/output saturation with optional envelope follower
evi.overdrive.env~.description:
evi.overdrive.env~ is a 'max define' for the evi_overdrive_env.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.overdrive.env~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A memoryless nonlinear approximation with antiderivative and oversampled processing. Can handle high gain input and remains well antialiased. An optional envelope follower allows for dynamic saturation.

evi.overdrive.fold~.digest: Antialiased tanh-based saturation, but folds it's input at high gain. Includes drive, input/output gain wrapping and filter shaping
evi.overdrive.fold~.description:
evi.overdrive.fold~ is a 'max define' for the evi_overdrive_fold.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.overdrive.fold~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

The most features of the evieve 'overdrive' objects, with drive, gain wrapping, additional input/output gain shaping and two damping filters which behave like a crossover, making it possible to control the amount of saturated and dry signal in the final output. The saturator is a tanh-like approximation but folds it's input at high gain, with antiderivative antialiasing and oversampling options. evi.overdrive.fold~ can be driven very hard and tonally shaped very easily making it a versatile nonlinear processor for a wide range of use cases. It is of course quite expensive.

evi.overdrive.wrap~.digest: Antialiased atan-based saturation with shape input to control overdrive and gain wrapping
evi.overdrive.wrap~.description:
evi.overdrive.wrap~ is a 'max define' for the evi_overdrive_wrap.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.overdrive.wrap~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This atan() overdrive is a simple but deluxe memoryless nonlinear processor with atan() gain wrapping around it's core nonlinearity (controlled via inlet 2) and various antialiasing options. The object can be driven very hard and maintains stability and clean/dirty sound.

evi.paf~.digest: A basic 'paf' formant oscillator, very similar to the legacy 'paf~' external
evi.paf~.description:
evi.paf~ is a 'max define' for the evi_paf.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.paf~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

'PAF' (phase aligned formant) is an oscillator that can model the human voice. Typically multiple PAF oscillators make up a formant model, as in evi.formantosc~. However single evi.paf~ instances can provide novel oscillators for more generic synthesis. The formant is controlled by frequency (inlet 2) and bandwidth (inlet 3). In this model the PAF is approximated by adding two 'wavepackets' together, which are also available separately on auxilliary outputs. The PAF algorithm is inherently bandlimited.

evi.pan~.description: Pan input(s) to output(s) using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'.

evi.phaser.analog~.digest: Analog Phaser effect with multiple stages, filtering and saturation
evi.phaser.analog~.description:
evi.phaser.analog~ is a 'max define' for the evi_phaser_analog.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.phaser.analog~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Analog-like phaser in the sort of pedal sense (good for mono input but still does quasi stereo well). Multple allpass filters are cascaded in series, with the amount setable via @stages. The feedback path is saturated and a crossover filter allows for selecting the frequency range of the input. The internal LFO can be shaped and skewed.

evi.phaseshift~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP phaseshift~ object as a TPT filter
evi.phaseshift~.description:
evi.phaseshift~ is a 'max define' for the evi_phaseshift.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.phaseshift~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A second order TPT allpass filter which distorts the phase of the signal. See the 'frequency-response' tab of the phaseshift~ helpfile for an explanation which is still accurate for this TPT version.

evi.phasor0~.digest: Zero-reset phasor with settings for reverse and pause
evi.phasor0~.description:
evi.phasor0~ is a 'max define' for the evi_phasor0.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.phasor0~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Zero-reset phasor like MSP [ phasor~ @syncupdate 1] with additional options for reverse and pause. Phase can also be set sample accurately and the phase can also be 'jumped' to with a message.

evi.plateverb~.digest: Plate reverb based on yafr2~ with additional filtering and smoothing
evi.plateverb~.description: Based on yafr2~ from MSP ('Plate reverb in the style of Griesinger' by Randy Jones). This version for evieve with dry/wet and eq added, as well as modifications for better filtering, interpolation and smoothing, and zero hold delay changes. Parameters normalised 0..1. Clickless and smooth changes possible for all parameters.

evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs.digest: Coefficients calculator for polyphase IIR halfband allpass quadrature hilbert filter cascade, outputs messages, dict and buffer~ arrays
evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs.description: evi.polyphaseiirhilbertcoeffs wraps js code that implements the Laurent de Soras HIIR library. Using this library we can calculate filter coefficients for high quality polyphase IIR halfband allpass cascades. In evieve the filter cascades are realised in standard evieve GenExpr code ( evi.hilbert~ and evi.freqshift.hilbert~).

evi.quadosc~.description: A quadrature oscillator which outputs phase synchronous cosine and sine waves.

evi.ramp0~.digest: Ramp generator, with options for zero-reset, loop, restingstate, curve and pause
evi.ramp0~.description:
evi.ramp0~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ramp0.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ramp0~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A bit like MSP ramp~, with options for zero-reset, loop, restingstate, curve and pause.

evi.randy~.digest: Cubic interpolated version of the linear MSP rand~
evi.randy~.description:
evi.randy~ is a 'max define' for the evi_randy.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.randy~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Being cubic interpolated the spectrum of this random oscillator rolls off much more steeply than the output of rand~, which may or may not be useful. At LFO frequencies this is a really useful smooth control source. @see: 'evi_sources.genexpr' and 'evi_lfo.genexpr' for more like this.

evi.rcfilter~.digest: Trapezoidal nonliner onepole rc filter emulation
evi.rcfilter~.description:
evi.rcfilter~ is a 'max define' for the evi_rcfilter.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.rcfilter~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A basic analog building block. Efficient, nonlinear analog onepole filter using trapezoidal integration and newton-raphson loop. @see: 'evi_rcfilters.genexpr' for details. A choice of frequency input in Hz (default) or normalised 0..1 (via the prewarp attribute). Optional smoothing is default off. @see: evi.onepole~ for a multimode linear version.

evi.rect.select~.description:
evi.rect.select~ is a 'max define' for the evi_rect_select.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.rect.select~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A collection of square-like oscillator shapes using a 2-point polyblep algorithm. Some shapes take PWM control. Also offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

evi.rect~.digest: Antialiased square wave oscillator with PWM
evi.rect~.description:
evi.rect~ is a 'max define' for the evi_rect.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.rect~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Simple antialiased square wave oscillator with PWM, based on 4-point polyblep algorithm. The highest quality of the evieve polyblep oscillators. Including high frequency compensation.

evi.rectify~.description:
evi.rectify~ is a 'max define' for the evi_rectify.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.rectify~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

evi.rectify~ is a simple passive audio signal rectifer. Rectification waveshapes an audio signal so that only positive vallues remain in the output giving a digital distorted effect. evi.rectify~ is antialiased via anti derivative antialiasing and dcblocked, so that the resulting signal is cleaner and softer than a mathematical rectification.

evi.reson~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP reson~ as a TPT filter
evi.reson~.description:
evi.reson~ is a 'max define' for the evi_reson.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.reson~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A linear TPT resonant bandpass filter. evi.reson~ has a very similar response as MSP reson~ and can therefore be used as a drop in replacement in most situations, but has better modulation characteristics with FM-able center frequency as well as optional auto gain compensation.

evi.ringmod.diode~.description: Piece-wise approximation of a 4-diode ring modulator, naive implementation heavily oversampled for clean antialiasing, so not very efficient. But it has it's own interesting sound and is very different to evi.ringmod~.

evi.ringmod~.description:
evi.ringmod~ is a 'max define' for the evi_ringmod.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.ringmod~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A clean FIR ring modulator algorithm with sine shaping saturation and filtering. Ring modulates two audio signals producing one modulated output, with antiderivative antialiasing and oversampling options.

evi.saw.select~.description:
evi.saw.select~ is a 'max define' for the evi_saw_select.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.saw.select~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A collection of saw-like oscillator shapes using a 2-point polyblep algorithm. Some shapes take PWM control. Also offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

evi.saw~.description:
evi.saw~ is a 'max define' for the evi_saw.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.saw~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Simple antialiased saw wave oscillator based on 4-point polyblep algorithm. The highest quality of the evieve polyblep oscillators. Including high frequency compensation.

evi.shaper~.digest: An interpolated choice of even or odd harmonics waveshaping
evi.shaper~.description:
evi.shaper~ is a 'max define' for the evi_shaper.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.shaper~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A simple object to cleanly add harmonics to an audio chain when required. A choice of up to 8-ish harmonics either even or odd can be smoothly interpolated onto the audio signal.

evi.sine.select~.description:
evi.sine.select~ is a 'max define' for the evi_sine_select.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.sine.select~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A collection of sine-like oscillator shapes using a 2-point polyblep algorithm. Offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

evi.sinfold~.description:
evi.sinfold~ is a 'max define' for the evi_sinfold.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.sinfold~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Unlike other evieve waveshapers, evi.sinfold~ focusses on mid/high harmonics. By increasing the @drive attribute the input gradually folds over. Can be driven hard with clean antialiased saturation.

evi.skfinputmix~.description:
evi.skfinputmix~ is a 'max define' for the evi_skfinputmix.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.skfinputmix~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A special kind of input mixing filter, where the multimode nature of the filter is provided by it's simultaneous inputs rather than on outputs. By default the inputs are mixed by the @mix attribute and therefore has the effect of output mixing a standard multimode Sallen Key. However if disabling the @mixenable attribute the inputs are 'always on', and can therefore be sequenced externally in interesting ways. This Sallen Key input mixer has excellent performance across a full range of cutoff frequencies. The filter is nonlinear and can take any sort of input.

evi.softclip~.description:
evi.softclip~ is a 'max define' for the evi_softclip.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.softclip~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A quick all purpose and efficient soft clipper. evi.softclip~ does not have all the options of evi.hardclip~ or evi.clipper~. It aims to be an easy tanh~ replacement to drop in to audio chains. The algorithm is a 2nd order antiderivative antialiasing tanh-like function.

evi.softstatic~.digest: Static antialiased soft clipping harmonics generator
evi.softstatic~.description:
evi.softstatic~ is a 'max define' for the evi_softstatic.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.softstatic~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A choice of two similar but different antialiased soft-ish / hard-ish static clipping algorithms

evi.squeeze~.description:
evi.squeeze~ is a 'max define' for the evi_squeeze.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.squeeze~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

evi.squeeze~ is a simple passive audio signal quadratic shaper. evi.squeeze~ is antialiased via anti derivative antialiasing, but is not designed for driving with high gain. Sadly this static waveshaper is expensive to compute.

evi.squine.simple~.digest: A basic implementation of Rasmus Ekman's 'squine wave' oscillator with audio rate modulation
evi.squine.simple~.description:
evi.squine.simple~ is a 'max define' for the evi_squine_simple.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.squine.simple~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An extremely versatile phase modulation oscillator which can morph shape and does not alias (up to a certain point). Inlets are available for linear and logarithmic FM modulation, as well as optionally audio rate control over the shape morphing.

evi.sustainverb~.digest: 16x16 FDN reverb with smooth sustaining effect
evi.sustainverb~.description: This is just Miller Puckette's 'rev3~' but with additional reverb features such as early reflections, filtering improvements and smoothing of parameters whilst maintaining the ability to forever sustain like the original. evi.sustainverb~ also includes multichannel taps of the FDN which can be very useful for surround-ish effects processing.

evi.svf~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP svf~ as a TPT filter
evi.svf~.description:
evi.svf~ is a 'max define' for the evi_svf.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.svf~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Linear TPT state variable filter with simultaneous outputs. The SVF is a really useful swiss-army-knife filter block and is very efficient. The evieve SVF can have it's parameters dynamically modulated up to audio rate whilst remaining clean and alias free. The internal filter structure of evi.svf~ is used in most of the other linear and nonlinear filters in the evieve package. Here it is presented in it's purest form to be as close to MSP svf~ as possible. Note, here we use MSP-like ordering of outputs, but in all other evieve SVFs we use a different ordering.

evi.svfinputmix~.description:
evi.svfinputmix~ is a 'max define' for the evi_svfinputmix.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.svfinputmix~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A special kind of input mixing filter, where the multimode nature of the filter is provided by it's simultaneous inputs rather than on outputs. By default the inputs are mixed by the @mix attribute and therefore has the effect of output mixing a standard multimode SVF. However if disabling the @mixenable attribute the inputs are 'always on', and can therefore be sequenced externally in interesting ways. This SVF input mixer has better performance with lower cutoff frequencies. For a more full range input mixer @see: evi.skfinputmixer~ (with a 'k').

evi.svfsmooth~.digest: Nonlinear TPT SVF filter with audio rate modulation and morphing capabilities
evi.svfsmooth~.description:
evi.svfsmooth~ is a 'max define' for the evi_svfsmooth.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.svfsmooth~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A cheap nonlinear 12dB multimode SVF for when you need a quick cheap synth filter. Morphing is between LP..BP..HP filters and is basic output-mixing with resonance attenuation, available at the far left outlet (1). All filters are also available individually via their multimode outlets 2, 3, 4 and 5 (lowpass, bandpass, highpass, notch).

evi.svfsynth~.digest: Nonlinear TPT SVF multimode synth filter with oversampling options
evi.svfsynth~.description:
evi.svfsynth~ is a 'max define' for the evi_svfsynth.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.svfsynth~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Beefy nonlinear TPT SVF filter with choice of 12/24dB slope, audio rate modulation and morphing capabilities. Morphing 12dB filter output is always available at the far left outlet. Optionally morphing 24dB filter output is avaiable at the far right outlet. Self oscillates at resonance==1 but can take higher resonance for interesting effects.

evi.teeth~.digest: Reimplementation of MSP teeth~ filter delay
evi.teeth~.description:
evi.teeth~ is a 'max define' for the evi_teeth.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.teeth~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Comb filter delay unit with independent control of feedforward and feedback delay times and saturation in the feedback path. The same structure as MSP teeth~, but with cubic interpolation (softer in the high end) and no digital clipping at FB Gain == 1 (via internal saturation, which makes the whole filter softer but will not clip your precious audio).

evi.tone.macro~.digest: A 'one knob' macroisation for nonlinear cut tone control useful for quick colourisation in your audio chain
evi.tone.macro~.description:
evi.tone.macro~ is a 'max define' for the evi_tone_macro.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.tone.macro~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Similar to evi.damp.macro~ but nonlinear so capable of driving audio input hard into the filter. The 'one knob' macroisation takes this into account. The effect is a dark saturated tone control for colourisation. Forms the output stage of evi.valve~.

evi.tpqm.description: A utility abstraction that allows for value scaling from a linear input map to a linear output map. Map three input points to three output points and linearly scale between them.

evi.transratio.digest: Convert semitones to pitch and vica versa
evi.transratio.description: Like the [transratio] abstraction but with multiple choices for input/output conversion.

evi.tremolo~.digest: Basic Tremolo effect with saturation and choice of LFO shapes
evi.tremolo~.description:
evi.tremolo~ is a 'max define' for the evi_tremolo.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.tremolo~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An example of a tremolo using evieve primitives. Variable control of LFOs for interesting modulation. The tremolo amplitude can be driven well above unity gain into an antialiased saturation stage.

evi.tri.select~.description:
evi.tri.select~ is a 'max define' for the evi_tri_select.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.tri.select~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A collection of tri-like oscillator shapes using a 2-point polyblep algorithm. Some shapes take PWM control. Also offers high frequency loss compensation filters and rudimentary oversampling. An experimental dynamic DC control is included, allowing for simultaneous use as LFOs and audio rate oscillators.

evi.tri~.description:
evi.tri~ is a 'max define' for the evi_tri.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.tri~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Simple antialiased tri wave oscillator based on 4-point polyblep algorithm. The highest quality of the evieve polyblep oscillators. Including high frequency compensation.

evi.vactrol~.digest: Vactrol response time domain filter envelope
evi.vactrol~.description: Analog modelled vactrol opto isolator envelope emulation.

evi.valve~.description:
evi.valve~ is a 'max define' for the evi_valve.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.valve~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

Antialiased valve (diode) distortion with dynamic envelope following network based around vactrol emulation as well as asymmetric processing. The object is like a guitar pre-amp with Baxandall EQ and high gain (scream/sustain) capabilities, but has been tuned with options to work on all sorts of input material. It is of course very expensive to compute.

evi.vcf~.description:
evi.vcf~ is a 'max define' for the evi_vcf.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.vcf~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

A twopole linear multimode filter. It is very interesting though. The Pd helpfile says of the cutoff frequency '...may change continuously in time as in an analog voltage controlled filter', but this is not true as it is a direct form filter. However, ymmv. [vcf~] is basically an audio rate version of [bp~] from Pd, which is also ported in evieve as evi.bp~.

evi.velvetnoise~.description:
evi.velvetnoise~ is a 'max define' for the evi_velvetnoise.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.velvetnoise~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This object can actually interpolate between 'sparse noise' and 'velvet noise' (first outlet via the second 'mix' inlet), but also outlets both 'sparse' and 'velvet' simultaneously from auxilliary outlets. The 'sparse noise' is an alternative to the evi.audiodust~ algorithm. Wikipedia: 'Velvet noise is a sparse sequence of random positive and negative impulses, typically characterised by its density in taps/second. At high densities it sounds similar to white noise. However, it is perceptually smoother.'

evi.vosim.basic~.digest: A basic implementation of a 'vosim' formant oscillator
evi.vosim.basic~.description:
evi.vosim.basic~ is a 'max define' for the evi_vosim_basic.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.vosim.basic~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This is a 'raw' formant oscillator with low level controls capable of modelling the human voice, typically used in a bank of multiple oscillators to do so. However single evi.vosim.basic~ instances can provide novel oscillators for more generic synthesis, and is capable of ringing filtered-like tones. The VOSIM algorithm is inherently bandlimited. This has since been put into the gen~ examples folder as 'gen~.vosim'.

evi.warmer~.description: Based on an idea by Tom Szilagyi. Contains two asymmetric saturation stages with a foldover boosting function and tone control filter. The effect can be blended between atan and asymmetric like behaviour, and the tonal characteristics can be continuously morphed.

evi.wavefolder.cascade~.digest: Antialiased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, selectable up to a cascade of 16 folding sections
evi.wavefolder.cascade~.description:
evi.wavefolder.cascade~ is a 'max define' for the evi_wavefolder_cascade.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.wavefolder.cascade~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An analog model of the 'Lockhart Wavefolder' employing antiderivative antialiasing via Lambert-W functions. The waveshaper takes a simple audio signal and aggressively folds and clips it to produce new shapes and harmonics in the style of west coast synthesis. This 'cascade' version has a variable order cascade of up to 16 stages, with CPU management depending on stages requested. See evi.wavefolder~ for a fixed version with less options.

evi.wavefolder~.digest: Antialiased wavefolder device for shaping oscillators, simultaneous outputs up to four stages
evi.wavefolder~.description:
evi.wavefolder~ is a 'max define' for the evi_wavefolder.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.wavefolder~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

An analog model of the 'Lockhart Wavefolder' employing antiderivative antialiasing via Lambert-W functions. The waveshaper takes a simple audio signal and aggressively folds and clips it to produce new shapes and harmonics in the style of west coast synthesis. This 'simple' version has a fixed cascade for four simultaneous outputs of 4 stages, 3 stages, 2 stages or 1 stage. See evi.wavefolder.cascade~ for a version with more options.

evi.weightingcoeffs.digest: Compute coefficients for A-weighting and other analytical filters and output for cascade~
evi.weightingcoeffs.description: evi.weightingcoeffs is simply a lookup table and is therefore extremely efficient. Coefficients are available for a wide range of samplerates and can therefore be used in a downsampled poly~ (for example).

evi.xfade~.description: Crossfades between inputs using an efficient cosine algorithm very close to a 'sqrt'. A choice of mono or stereo setups.

evi.zeroxcount~.digest: Like MSP zerox~ with controls for window size and threshold, with simultaneous analysis outputs
evi.zeroxcount~.description:
evi.zeroxcount~ is a 'max define' for the evi_zeroxcount.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.zeroxcount~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This was built for a very specific need but might be useful as a controller. It is very similar to the RNBO 'zerox_count~' object but with simultaneous outlets for a > threshold gate and # of crossings.

evi.zeroxoscnoise~.digest: An automatic crossfading oscillators / noise source via audio analysis, e.g. used in vocoders
evi.zeroxoscnoise~.description:
evi.zeroxoscnoise~ is a 'max define' for the evi_zeroxoscnoise.gendsp gen~ abstraction. Because evi.zeroxoscnoise~ is a 'max define' it also accepts all messages and attributes that a gen~ object does. 

This object produces a mix of bandlimited oscillators and coloured noise via an envelope created by a zerocrossing detector on the audio input. This is a classic source for a vocoder type effect, but is also an interesting audio source in it's own right. The type of oscillator and the type of noise can be morphed in realtime. The default oscillator is a non-bandlimited train pulse for glottal excitation, but using the other bandlimited oscillators gives a solid synth like source. The noise types morph between sparse (dust), velvet and gaussian (almost white). The envelope produced by the audio input zero crossings can be smoothed from linear to vactrol-like control shapes.

evi.zitaverb~.digest: True stereo FDN/algorithmic reverb based on 'zitaverb' by Fons Adriaensen
evi.zitaverb~.description: A famous open source reverb algorithm with excellent room realness. GPL v2. The evieve version increases the available RT60 times for special effects, and smooths all parameters, as well as improving the internal filtering.

mc.evi.bands~.digest: Evenly distribute resonant filter bands across a spectrum
mc.evi.bands~.description: An evieve version of the native mc.bands~ abstraction. In evieve the filters are updated to use TPT resonant filters, as well as some minor optimisations and utilities.

mc.evi.listgen.digest: Create message lists with mcwrapper features
mc.evi.listgen.description: Create message lists with mcwrapper features. A simple hack using mc.gen to accept mcwrapper commands and output max message rate lists with the resultant data. Also see mcwrapper-group.
